summary: Indexed lookup into a global driver data table. Given a driver index a1, returns dword_5BF9A0[5 * a1] when the index is not -1; otherwise returns -1 unchanged. Called only by InsertDriverTableEntry, consistent with a helper that retrieves one element of a per-driver table whose stride is five dwords.

operations.description: Initialize result to a1 so the sentinel value survives the guard.
Guard on a1 != -1; a -1 index bypasses the table read.
Return the table element dword_5BF9A0[5 * a1], reading the global driver data table at a five-dword stride per index.
Return a1 unchanged when the guard fails, i.e. for the -1 sentinel index.

unresolved: Entry layout: the 5-dword stride implies a fixed per-driver record, but its fields are not evident here.
Caller InsertDriverTableEntry 0x00418560 is the only use site; the semantic role of the returned dword (an id, flag, or pointer) is unproven.
